title: Sentinel Runtime Canonical Event
description: Runtime event contract shared by evidence processors, correlation, and investigation APIs.

event_id.description: Stable event identifier generated by the evidence processor.

case_id.description: Investigation case identifier. Null is allowed for offline/batch processing.

timestamp.description: Runtime event timestamp. Null is retained for provenance and skipped by timeline construction.

timestamp_start.description: Start timestamp used by interval-based/video events.

timestamp_end.description: Optional end timestamp for interval-based events.

source.description: Runtime modality label, such as cyber, physical, video, or document.

source_type.description: Evidence source type. New source types may be added without breaking older readers.

source_id.description: Evidence identifier linking this event to its source file or record.

actor_id.description: Raw actor identifier before entity resolution.

action.description: Observed action from the evidence processor.

minimum_travel_minutes_from_previous_loc.description: Optional source-provided minimum transit time from the previous recorded location.
